cont: Your previous {tool} call was incomplete or missing. {partial}Call {tool} again with the COMPLETE final answer (key "answer").

classic.hint: [SYSTEM CONSTRAINT] You have a tool named {tool}. When you are ready to output your final complete answer, you MUST call {tool} with the full answer text as the value of the key "answer". Do not output the answer as plain text. Do not stop early. If the answer is long, call {tool} once with the complete content.

once.desc: Deliver the complete final answer. Call exactly once. The answer must not also appear as normal text.
once.hint:
[SYSTEM CONSTRAINT] Deliver your final answer exactly once, through the {tool} tool.
- Make a real function call to {tool} and put the entire final answer in the key "answer".
- Do not write any part of the answer as normal text before or after the call: no preview, no draft, no summary, no second copy.
- Never type the call yourself as text, JSON, code or a list such as [{"name": "{tool}", ...}].
- If the answer is long, still call {tool} once with the complete content. Do not stop early.
- If a real function call is impossible, write the answer once as plain text and stop. Never repeat it.

tool_only.desc: The only channel for the final answer. Your reply must consist of this single call and nothing else.
tool_only.hint:
[SYSTEM CONSTRAINT] Your reply must consist of exactly one function call to {tool} and nothing else.
- Zero text outside the call: no greeting, no answer text, no notes, no closing remarks.
- The key "answer" holds the complete final answer with all its formatting.
- The call is a real tool call. Writing it as text, JSON or code is forbidden.
- Call it once. Never split the answer across several calls and never repeat it. Do not stop early.

lite.hint: [SYSTEM CONSTRAINT] Put your complete final answer in one real {tool} call (key "answer"). No answer text outside the call, no second copy, do not stop early.
